args.assumptions: Land required = 50 MW x 1.6 ha/MW = 80 ha. Suitable = landcover cropland (1) or scrub (2), AND slope <= 7 degrees (Horn slope, cells with slope exactly 7 included), AND not inside protected areas or their buffers (A: 250 m, B: 400 m, buffers applied to each designation's polygons and rasterised by cell centre; the protected polygons themselves are excluded since they lie within their buffers), AND cell-centre distance to the 132 kV HV line <= 5 km. The DEM had no nodata cells, so no nodata exclusions were needed. Maximum line distance in the grid is 1.8 km, so the distance criterion excludes nothing. Parcels are 8-connected; 6 patches, largest 375.44 ha. Clear-sky yield is the pvlib Ineichen upper bound at 30 degree fixed tilt, PR 0.80, 50 MW, not a bankable estimate.

Suitable = slope <= 5 deg (Horn slope on dem, degrees) AND landcover in {cropland 1, scrub 2} AND centre not inside/within 150 m of designation A areas AND centre not inside/within 500 m of designation B areas AND centre within 10 km of grid_line (132 kV). Vectors reprojected from EPSG:4326 to EPSG:32630 before buffering (buffers in metres). Buffers and zones judged at cell centres (rasterize all_touched=false). DEM has no nodata cells, so no nodata exclusion applied beyond tool behaviour. Max distance to line in the study area is 1.8 km, so the distance criterion excludes nothing. Required land = 80 MW x 2 ha/MW = 160 ha; largest 8-connected parcel 254.94 ha (8 patches total) so feasible. Suitable area 4872 cells x 0.0625 ha = 304.5 ha. Clear-sky yield from tool (Ineichen, fixed 30 deg tilt, PR 0.80) is an upper bound, not a bankable yield.

Required land = 80 MW x 2 ha/MW = 160 ha; largest 8-connected parcel is 23.69 ha (28 patches), so the site is infeasible and yield is set to 0 per the rule (the clear-sky tool was not run). Assumptions: dem value -9999 declared as nodata (dem had no nodata flag set) and slope computed from it, so cells touching nodata are excluded; slope <= 3 deg kept (inclusive); suitable land classes are cropland (1) and scrub (2); protected areas excluded along with their buffers (A: 250 m, B: 500 m), judged at cell centres with the buffer polygons rasterized using centre-inside rule; line distance max is 1800 m so all cells are within the 8 km limit; 25 m cells = 0.0625 ha each.

Suitable = cropland or scrub AND slope <= 7 deg (Horn slope, cell-centre test, inclusive) AND cell centre not inside a designation A protected area buffered 150 m or designation B buffered 600 m (buffer includes the protected polygon itself) AND cell centre within 5 km of the 132 kV line. The protected_areas layer had one self-intersecting polygon (PA-2, B); repaired with fix_geometry before buffering. DEM has no nodata cells, so no extra exclusions. Line distance max in grid is 1.8 km, so the 5 km limit is not binding. Required land = 30 MW x 1.6 ha/MW = 48 ha; largest 8-connected parcel 368.75 ha (6 patches) exceeds this. Yield is the tool's clear-sky Ineichen upper bound at 30 MW, 30 deg tilt, PR 0.80, not a bankable estimate. Area is cell count x 0.0625 ha (25 m cells).

Required land = 50 MW x 4 acres/MW = 200 acres = 80.94 ha. Slope from DEM (Horn, percent) must be <= 5%. Landcover classes 1 (cropland) and 2 (scrub) only. No DEM nodata cells were found, so no nodata exclusion applied. Protected-area buffers: designation A 650 ft = 198.12 m, designation B 1650 ft = 502.92 m, buffered separately and burned at cell centres (not all-touched); union of both excluded. HV line (132 kV) distance max is 1800 m across the grid, so the 6-mile (9656 m) constraint excludes nothing. Parcels use 8-connectivity. Suitable area = 2067 cells x 0.0625 ha. Largest parcel (33.4 ha, 22 patches) is below the 80.94 ha required, so the site is not feasible and the yield is reported as 0; the clear-sky figure for a 50 MW, 30-degree, PR 0.80 system would be 94.2 GWh but is not applicable. Mask 'suit_mask' is the suitability layer before parcel selection.

Required land = 30 MW x 4.94 ac/MW = 148.2 ac = 59.98 ha. 984 ft = 299.92 m buffer applied to designation A (2 features) and B (1 feature) polygons, reprojected from EPSG:4326 to UTM 32630; cells rasterized by centre (default, not all_touched). Line distance limit 4.97 mi = 7998.44 m; the max distance to the HV line on the grid is 1800 m, so the line constraint excludes nothing. Slope in percent (Horn) <= 8.75 kept; DEM has no nodata cells. Landcover classes 1 (cropland) and 2 (scrub) only. Suitable = slope ok AND landcover ok AND NOT inside any A or B buffer. Cell area 0.0625 ha. Largest parcel by 8-connectivity: 10 patches, largest 158.8 ha, well above the 59.98 ha needed. Yield is the pvlib clear-sky upper bound for 30 MW, 30 deg tilt, PR 0.80, not a bankable estimate.

Protected-area buffers: designation A 800 ft = 243.84 m, designation B 2000 ft = 609.6 m, applied to all features of each designation and rasterised by cell centre; buffer zones (including the protected polygons themselves) excluded. Cell area 0.0625 ha.

Note the clear-sky yield is for the stated 30 MW capacity, not the suitable area.

Suitable = landcover cropland (1) or scrub (2), AND slope <= 7 deg (Horn slope, cell-centre test, degrees), AND distance to 132 kV grid_line <= 5 km (cell-centre), AND NOT inside protected areas: designation A buffered 250 m, designation B buffered 500 m (cell-centre test). Inputs: 25 m grid (625 m², 0.0625 ha per cell). DEM has -9999 values with no declared nodata; I declared -9999 as nodata (887 cells), and slope (Horn, percent) is nodata for those cells and any cell touching them, so they are excluded. Slope limit 5 percent (<=5 kept). Land cover: cropland (1) and scrub (2) only. Protected areas: designation A buffered 500 ft = 152.4 m, designation B buffered 2000 ft = 609.6 m; a cell is excluded if its centre falls inside the polygon or its buffer. Line criterion: 5 mi = 8046.72 m; the maximum distance from any cell to the 132 kV line is ~1996 m, so every cell meets the grid-distance requirement and it did not constrain the result. Required land: 50 MW x 5 acres/MW = 250 acres = 101.17 ha. Largest parcel is 57.31 ha (8-connected, 17 patches total), which is below 101.17 ha, so the site is not feasible and the yield is reported as 0 per the rules. The clear-sky yield tool was not run for this reason. Suitable mask 'suitable' = slope<=5% AND cropland/scrub AND NOT in protected zones: 2110 cells, 131.875 ha.

Required land = 30 MW x 4.94 ac/MW = 148.2 ha. Slope computed in percent (Horn) from dem and tested <= 8.75%; dem has no nodata cells so no edge exclusions were needed. Land cover: cropland (1) and scrub (2) only. Protected area PA-3 and PA-1 (designation A) and PA-2 (B) buffered by 984 ft = 299.92 m; the self-intersecting polygon (PA-1) was repaired before buffering; buffer and polygon cells excluded when cell centre lies inside. Line: 4.97 mi = 7998.44 m; distance from cell centre to HV line tested <= that; this constraint is non-binding (max distance on grid ~1996 m). Parcels 8-connected: 7 patches, largest 173.6 ha (feasible vs 148.2 ha). Yield from clear-sky Ineichen model at 30 MW, 30 deg tilt, PR 0.80: 56.5 GWh/yr, an upper bound only.
